name: Lottie Runtime Adapter
summary: Embed Lottie and dotLottie animations with playback that can be sought deterministically by HyperFrames.
problem: Pre-rendered Lottie timelines may show the wrong frame unless player state is coordinated with the composition renderer.
coreOutcomes: Embed Lottie or dotLottie player assets
Register player instances for deterministic seeking
Validate animation behavior at requested composition times
requirements: A Lottie JSON or dotLottie asset and compatible player runtime
boundaries: Covers player integration, not exporting or editing the source animation
The source animation remains subject to its own license and asset requirements
